---
title: "ctmc survival"
format: html
---


```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(expm)
library(ggplot2)

# Generator matrix for Cohort A (Treatment A)
Q_A <- matrix(c(-0.1,  0.08, 0.02,   # Health → Disease or Death
                0.00, -0.2,  0.2,    # Disease → Death
                0.00,  0.00,  0.00), # Death is absorbing
              nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Generator matrix for Cohort B (Treatment B - more aggressive intervention)
Q_B <- matrix(c(-0.1,  0.09, 0.01,   # Health → Disease or Death
                0.00, -0.3,  0.3,    # Disease → Death (faster progression)
                0.00,  0.00,  0.00),
              nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Initial state: all patients start in Health
p0 <- c(1, 0, 0)

# Time points
time_points <- seq(0, 50, by = 0.5)

# Survival probabilities for each cohort
survival_A <- sapply(time_points, function(t) {
  P_t <- expm(Q_A * t)
  p_t <- p0 %*% P_t
  return(p_t[1] + p_t[2])  # Still in Health or Disease
})

survival_B <- sapply(time_points, function(t) {
  P_t <- expm(Q_B * t)
  p_t <- p0 %*% P_t
  return(p_t[1] + p_t[2])
})

# Combine into one data frame
df <- data.frame(
  time = rep(time_points, 2),
  survival = c(survival_A, survival_B),
  cohort = rep(c("Treatment A", "Treatment B"), each = length(time_points))
)

# Plot survival curves
ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = survival, color = cohort)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Survival Curves for Two Treatment Cohorts",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Survival Probability (Not in Death State)",
       color = "Cohort") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(expm)
library(ggplot2)

# Define generator matrix Q for CTMC
# States: 1 = Health, 2 = Disease, 3 = Death (absorbing)
Q <- matrix(c(-0.1,  0.08, 0.02,   # Health → Disease or Death
              0.00, -0.2,  0.2,    # Disease → Death
              0.00,  0.00,  0.00), # Death is absorbing
            nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Initial state: all patients start in Health
p0 <- c(1, 0, 0)

# Time points
time_points <- seq(0, 50, by = 0.5)

# Compute survival probabilities: not yet in Death state
survival_probs <- sapply(time_points, function(t) {
  P_t <- expm(Q * t)
  p_t <- p0 %*% P_t
  return(p_t[1] + p_t[2])  # Still in Health or Disease
})

# Create data frame
df <- data.frame(
  time = time_points,
  survival = survival_probs
)

# Plot survival curve
ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = survival)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Survival Curve: CTMC Disease Progression",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Survival Probability (Not in Death State)") +
  theme_minimal()

```





```{r}
# Generator matrix Q (example)
Q <- matrix(c(-2, 2, 0,
              1, -3, 2,
              0, 1, -1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Initial state: starting in state 1
p0 <- c(1, 0, 0)

# Time points
time_points <- seq(0, 10, by = 0.1)

# Compute survival probabilities: staying in state 1
survival_probs <- sapply(time_points, function(t) {
  P_t <- expm(Q * t)
  p_t <- p0 %*% P_t
  return(p_t[1])  # Probability of being in state 1 at time t
})

```

```{r}
# Create data frame
df <- data.frame(
  time = time_points,
  survival = survival_probs
)

# Plot survival curve
ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = survival)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Survival Curve: CTMC (State 1)",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Probability of Remaining in State 1") +
  theme_minimal()

```
